notes.title: Patch 1.05 Released!
notes.notes:
-Added “Wait” Battle Mode
-Added Fast Forward button

-Characters that “get back up” will have a bit more health and have their action bar partially filled, allowing them to act sooner
Buffed large and major mana/health potions

Fixed shadows at Possibility Point
Fixed being able to talk to “dead” guards in Darin intro section
Fixed controller triggers not being able to be bound properly
Other fixes (no spoilers!)

Known Issue(s): Rarely, you may encounter a bug where you cannot speak to anyone. Exit the game and re-launch and it should be fixed.
